description: This file defines the ModBinary class, which extends AbstractBinary, representing a binary modulus operation node in Twig's expression language. It specifically implements the operator method that outputs the '%' operator in compiled PHP code.

classes.name: ModBinary
classes.description: A class representing the modulus binary operation in Twig's expression syntax, responsible for generating the '%' operator during template compilation.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Outputs the '%' operator for the modulus operation during compilation.
